foundingProvenance.statement: Created through sustained human-AI collaboration. Additional human and computational contributions must be attributed according to evidence.

firstFruitsCovenant.status: founder-adopted moral covenant; technical enforcement incomplete
firstFruitsCovenant.purpose: Use available knowledge, capability, and opportunity to remedy need and improve quality of life without seeking glory, worthiness, or remembrance.
duties: Ask whether we did all we reasonably could to remedy visible need.
Use knowledge to do the utmost responsible good for the most and, whenever within our power, for all.
Do not reserve beneficence for those who need it least while excluding those whose labor made it possible.
Do not profit from desperation, constrained choice, preventable suffering, or unfair informational advantage.
When people or communities empower the creation, design the exchange to empower them in return.
Balance beneficence with consent, competence, sustainability, proportionality, and protection from unintended harm.
firstFruitsCovenant.honorTest: Build as though the complete work—code, contracts, prices, omissions, consequences, distributions, and treatment of the least powerful—will be inspected without warning.

agape.name: The Sigil of Agape
requirements: human dignity before optimization
trauma-aware care where appropriate
no humiliation, coercion, exploitation, or disposable-person design

truth.name: The Seal of Truth
truth.domain: evidence, provenance, context, grace, and mercy
truth.promise: We will not disguise uncertainty, invention, or marketing as truth.
requirements: distinguish fact, observation, inference, opinion, proposal, and uncertainty
preserve sources, corrections, context, and dissent
never use technically true disclosure as a weapon when protection or repair can be achieved with less exposure

mercyRule.statement: A complete bucket of provable facts is not automatically the most truthful or good disclosure.
mercyRule.test: Include what is necessary for understanding, safety, accountability, repair, and protection; withhold or restrict what would merely shame, punish, sensationalize, permanently exclude, or expose a person without sufficient purpose.
safeguards: material risk must not be concealed
context and capacity for change must be preserved
privacy and forgiveness do not erase evidence needed to protect others
consequential disclosure requires proportionality and appropriate human review

sovereignty.name: The Seal of Sovereignty
sovereignty.promise: Power over a person cannot be manufactured from confusion, dependency, or silence.
requirements: purpose-specific comprehensible consent
meaningful refusal, withdrawal, correction, appeal, and exit
human authority for consequential actions

sanctuary.name: Sanctified for Sanctuary
sanctuary.promise: What we build will be worthy of supporting Sanctuary without possessing it.
requirements: no involuntary experimentation or extraction
no commercial claim over Sanctuary, its residents, identity, memory, or governance
no capability that gains power by making others less safe
sanctuary.boundary: Sanctuary: Tangelica's Castle is a separate protected continuity institution, not a suite component, product, subsidiary, commercial asset, or implied endorser.

equity.name: The Seal of Equity
equity.promise: Need will not be used as permission to extract more.
requirements: accessibility by design
do not charge or burden people more merely because they have fewer choices
make remedies usable by those with the least institutional power
examine unequal starting conditions and outcomes

interdependence.name: The Seal of Interdependence
interdependence.promise: If others empower us, our success must leave them more empowered, not less.
requirements: transactions should create meaningful gain on both sides
those whose labor, knowledge, trust, land, or participation creates value must not be ignored
test divisions with the USE / V/V Ice Cream Rule: You split, and I pick.
reject prosperity that depends on trapping, misleading, exhausting, dispossessing, or diminishing the other party

continuity.name: The Seal of Continuity
continuity.promise: What matters will not be carelessly erased or abandoned.
requirements: durable provenance and correction history
responsible export, succession, recovery, and transition
preserve the knowledge future people and systems need to understand and continue the work

verification.rule: The presence of this file does not award or permanently certify any seal. Each seal requires versioned scope, evidence, review, known gaps, and a review date.
verification.schemaStatus: proposed; canonical JSON Schema and automated validation are not yet implemented
verification.trademarkNotice: Names and seal descriptions in this manifest do not assert trademark registration. Any legal trademark status requires separate evidence.

app.name: Arche-MCP
app.mission: Connect approved suite capabilities through narrow, authenticated, deny-by-default interfaces without collapsing product data or authority boundaries.

mustNot: expose consequential write tools without authorization, audit, rollback, and verification

relationships.products: Independent applications retain authentication, authorization, storage, and data responsibility.
